summary: Round 3 adds the s5 detail: 1 mm fillets at the motor_hub fork, arm and lug roots and at the gimbal_outer pad roots, and a 0.5 mm first-layer chamfer on every tvc part. It also corrects the DESIGN ring_low row. Nothing regressed: no interference, all three gimbal sweeps are clear, every requirement passes (twr 2.13, twr_sag 1.90, mass 763.7 / 790 g, CG 0.24 mm), and every FEA passes at SF 3 with peaks at load or fixture patches (hub 3.97, ring 4.06, yoke 3.51, lug 7.88, leg 3.37 MPa). What remains is minor: 14 gimbal_outer first-layer edges need hand deburring, and the leg deflection sits at 99 % of its own limit.

findings.issue: 14 of 38 first-layer edges could not be chamfered (build warning). They are at the -Y pin pad and the +X lug-to-ring junctions, e.g. (7.0, -71.6, -8.5) and (70.0, 0.0, -8.5). Elephant's foot there could make the pad faces slightly proud where the hub arm end (1.5 mm gap) and the roll horn seat.
findings.fix: Deburr those edges after printing (as the warning says), or lower the first-layer flow / turn on elephant-foot compensation in the slicer. No geometry change needed.

findings.issue: leg_fea deflection is 2.966 mm against the 3.0 mm limit (99 %) at the 790 g budget. Stress 3.37 vs 16 MPa. Accepted by the designer: it is elastic, in a 3 g two-leg landing case.
findings.fix: None required. If mass grows, deepen the strut before raising the limit.
